summary: Bangkok Prep is an international school offering an English National Curriculum from nursery to sixth form, with visa support for enrolling families.

facts.label: Student visa support
facts.value: Government Liaison Officer helps families with Non-Ed and parent visa applications
facts.quote: Our Government Liaison Officer (GLO) supports international families

facts.label: Languages taught
facts.value: Thai, Japanese, Spanish, French or Mandarin alongside English support
facts.quote: Receive English language support while mastering Thai, Japanese, Spanish, French or Mandarin.
